experiment: The v6.2 DMA-stop fix on hardware: in ONE boot on the FAT32 card, a new Sword of the Berserk dump was stopped with B, resumed with X, interrupted by opening the lid, and resumed again to the end.

segments.ended: CAPTURED all 3 tracks; Reference check (TOSEC): FULL TRACK MATCH

conclusions: DMA stayed on after a B stop and after a lid-open in the same boot: both resumed segments ran at DMA speed with disc time under 1%, and 'DMA stays off until reboot' appears nowhere.
The dump, interrupted twice and resumed twice, matched TOSEC on every track.
